name: leadflow
description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for German mortgage brokerages

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
